title: Cut the first codeality-go release: annotated tag packages/codeality-go/v0.1.0 once the Go CI job is green on main
notes: The CI job that codeality-go init --ci writes installs codeality-go@v0.1.0, which resolves only after this tag exists. A Go tag is cached by the module proxy and cannot be moved.
